description: Rule selection on train routes only (High quality, random 300). Val and pilot untouched.

chosen.rule: lowest mean official score on these train routes, within each family

S.solver: OR-Tools routing (constraint_solver), one vehicle, closed tour from the station
S.cost_units: travel time in tenths of a second (integers)

zone_order_tsp.solver: same OR-Tools settings, closed tour station -> zones -> station
zone_order_tsp.zone_distance: mean travel time over all (stop in zone a, stop in zone b) pairs; station row/column the same with the station as a one-stop zone

inside_zone.solver: same OR-Tools settings, open path with fixed start and end node
inside_zone.start: last stop of the previous zone (the station for the first zone)
inside_zone.end: dummy node; cost from a stop = travel time to the nearest stop of the next zone (to the station after the last zone)

settings.zoneless_stops: stops with a missing zone or one not matching A-2.1C take the zone of the zoned stop with the smallest round-trip travel time
settings.id_rule_direction: every ID-rule variant is costed as a closed zone tour on the zone matrix; the cheapest variant is used (this includes ascending vs descending)
settings.bootstrap: 10000 percentile resamples of routes, numpy default_rng(20261111)
settings.sign_test: exact two-sided binomial test on routes with a non-zero difference
